about.description: Icehouse Tap Room is a local neighborhood beach bar and restaurant located on Little Lagoon in Gulf Shores, offering uninterrupted sunset views 365 days a year. Founded in 2000 in Baton Rouge, LA, it has expanded to Gulf Shores. The restaurant features a funky indoor space and beachy outdoor space with over 30 years of family-owned bar and restaurant experience. Not corporate driven, offering full menu with made-to-order items and 24 beers on tap.
about.elevator_pitch: A family-owned beach bar and restaurant with uninterrupted sunset views, 24 craft beers on tap, and late-night dining in Gulf Shores.
about.vibe: Casual, local, laid-back beach atmosphere with funky indoor and beachy outdoor spaces. A gathering place for friends, wanderers, and adventurers.
about.insider_tip: Open later than most businesses in the area with food service after midnight. Located directly behind the Original Oyster House on Hwy 59, two lights north of The Hangout. Try the house-made BBQ sauce and smoked boudin gumbo.
